name: Delivery Confirmation via Spreadsheet
description:
Handles delivery confirmation via OTP, updates Google Sheets, and WooCommerce. 
Required Environment Variables:
- OTP_TRACKING_SHEET_ID: Google Sheet ID for the OTP tracking master list.
- OTP_TRACKING_SHEET_NAME: Sheet name (tab name) within the OTP_TRACKING_SHEET_ID for OTP data.
- DELIVERY_FORM_RESPONSES_SHEET_ID: Google Sheet ID for logging all delivery form responses/attempts.
- DELIVERY_FORM_RESPONSES_SHEET_NAME: Sheet name (tab name) for the delivery responses log.
